name: Fibre, Yarn, Spinning and Sizing Chemicals
description: Formulations and lubricants used during fibre processing, yarn spinning, warping, and warp sizing to reduce friction, prevent static, and protect yarn during high-speed weaving.
keyApplications: Ring spinning & rotor spinning
Warp yarn preparation on sizing machines
Circular and flat knitting lubrication
Starch and synthetic blend weaving protection
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated based on yarn friction coefficient reduction, ease of desizing in subsequent wet processing, COD/BOD load during washing, and thermal stability during weaving.

name: Textile Pretreatment Chemicals
description: Essential chemical auxiliaries used in fabric desizing, scouring, degreasing, and chelating to remove natural impurities, seed coats, waxes, and sizing agents prior to dyeing or printing.
keyApplications: Continuous bleaching ranges (CBR)
Soft-flow and jet processing machines
Knit and woven fabric preparation baths
Mercerising and causticising liquors
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by Draves wetting speed, wax and oil saponification efficiency, residual size rating (Tegewa scale), calcium/magnesium chelation capacity, and low-foaming profile under high liquor agitation.

name: Textile Bleaching Chemicals
description: Formulations used in oxidative and reductive bleaching to destroy natural coloring matter in fibres and achieve uniform base whiteness before dyeing or optical brightening.
keyApplications: Cotton yarn and knit bleaching
Continuous bleaching ranges for woven fabrics
Peroxide neutralisation baths prior to reactive dyeing
Full-white finish fabric production
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by peroxide decomposition rate control, preservation of fibre tensile strength, absence of silicate scale build-up in machinery, and complete elimination of residual peroxide to prevent dye reduction.

name: Textile Dyeing Auxiliaries
description: Specialised chemical additives that regulate dye bath conditions, promote uniform liquor penetration, control dye migration, and prevent batch unlevelness across diverse fibre types and machinery.
chemicalFamilies: Levelling Agents for Reactive, Disperse & Acid Dyes
keyApplications: Exhaust dyeing in jet, overflow, and package yarn machines
Thermosol continuous dyeing ranges
High-temperature (HT) polyester dyeing at 130°C
Cotton reactive dyeing in soft-flow machines
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by dye retarder/migrating balance, strike rate control, high-temperature emulsion stability, oligomer dispersion in polyester dyeing, and compatibility with specific dye ionic classes.

name: Textile Dyes and Colourants
description: Chromophoric colourant molecules that chemically bond or physically disperse within textile fibres. Treated as a distinct product family separate from processing auxiliaries.
chemicalFamilies: Reactive Dyes (Cold & Warm Brand, Bifunctional, High Exhaustion)
keyApplications: Cellulosic fibre coloration
Polyester, acetate, and triacetate coloration
Polyamide (Nylon) and wool coloration
Garment piece dyeing and printing pastes
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by light fastness, wash fastness (ISO 105-C06), rubbing fastness, perspiration fastness, exhaustion rate, fixation percentage, and shade consistency from lot to lot.

name: Textile Printing Chemicals
description: Polymeric thickeners, film-forming binders, crosslinking agents, and auxiliaries that control print paste rheology, prevent paste bleeding, and fix pigments or reactive dyes on fabric surfaces.
keyApplications: Rotary screen printing on cotton and knits
Flatbed printing tables and automatic flat screen machines
Pigment printing for home textiles and dress materials
Discharge and resist printing techniques
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by paste viscosity yield, pattern edge sharpness, soft handle after binder curing, washing and crocking fastness, screen choke resistance, and runnability at high squeegee speeds.

name: After-treatment and Washing Chemicals
description: Chemicals designed to remove unfixed surface dyes, neutralise residual processing alkali/acid, prevent re-deposition during rinsing, and chemically fix dyes to maximise wet and wash fastness.
chemicalFamilies: Reduction Clearing Agents for Disperse Dyes
keyApplications: Post-reactive dyeing soaping sequences
Reduction clearing of dyed polyester at 70-80°C
Direct dye fixation for apparel fabrics
Garment wash cycles to prevent pocket/label staining
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by wash fastness improvement (ISO 105-C06), reduction in wash-off bath cycles to conserve water and steam, non-impairment of original shade tone, and absence of formaldehyde emissions.

name: Optical Brighteners and Whitening Agents
description: Fluorescent whitening agents (FWAs) that absorb invisible ultraviolet radiation and re-emit it in the visible blue-violet spectrum, counteracting natural yellowness to yield brilliant white finishes.
chemicalFamilies: High-Temperature Stable OBAs for Synthetic Blends
keyApplications: Exhaust application on bleached cotton knits and yarns
Padding and stenter thermofixation on polyester and synthetic blends
Combined peroxide bleaching and brightening baths
Medical, hospitality, and shirting textiles requiring high CIE whiteness index
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by Berger and Ganz whiteness index, greening/yellowing threshold concentration (over-brightening limit), light fastness, and compatibility with peroxide or resin baths.

name: Textile Softening and Finishing Chemicals
description: Functional emulsions and fatty conditioning compounds applied during final fabric stenter or exhaust finishing to impart desired softness, drape, bulk, smoothness, and sewability.
keyApplications: Stenter pad-dry-cure finishing of wovens and knits
Exhaust softening in winches and soft-flow machines
Toweling and knitwear requiring instant water absorbency
Garment laundry tumble finishing
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by surface smoothness (hand-feel), shade alteration/yellowing index upon stenter drying, rewettability (water droplet absorption time), tear strength preservation, and shear stability in padding mangles.

name: Functional and Specialty Finishes
description: High-performance chemical finishes that impart specific functional properties such as water repellence, antistatic dissipation, soil release, moisture management, or flame resistance.
keyApplications: Outdoor activewear and sportswear
Workwear and protective industrial uniforms
Automotive and technical textile fabrics
Home furnishings and contract drapery
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated against standard test methods (AATCC 22 spray rating, AATCC 76 surface resistivity, ISO wash durability). Requires verified documentation regarding chemical restrictions and regulatory conformance.

name: Garment Washing and Denim Chemicals
description: Enzymes, fading auxiliaries, anti-back-staining polymers, and specialty washing chemicals formulated for industrial laundry machines and denim finishing.
chemicalFamilies: Ozone and Laser Compatible Processing Aids
keyApplications: Denim stone-wash alternatives (enzyme abrasion)
Garment overdyeing and vintage fading effects
Towel and casualwear bio-polishing to eliminate surface hairiness
Industrial garment wash houses
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by abrasion contrast, indigo back-staining prevention on white pocket bags and weft yarns, fabric tensile and tear strength retention, and operating pH/temperature tolerance.

name: Textile Coating, Lamination and Technical Textile Chemicals
description: Polymer compounds, adhesives, and additives applied as surface coatings or bonding layers to create impermeable, reinforced, or specialty technical fabrics.
keyApplications: Waterproof breathable textile coatings
Blackout curtain and upholstery back-coatings
Fabric-to-fabric and membrane lamination
Industrial conveyor, tarpaulin, and protective textiles
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by hydrostatic head pressure resistance, peel bond strength, flexibility at sub-zero temperatures, breathability (water vapour transmission rate), and wash/dry-clean durability.

name: Textile Water and Effluent Treatment Chemicals
description: Industrial wastewater chemicals used in textile processing mills to decolourise dye effluent, neutralise pH, coagulate suspended solids, and condition boiler or cooling tower water.
keyApplications: Textile processing mill effluent treatment plants (ETP)
Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) recovery systems
Raw process water softening and filtration
High-colour reactive dye wastewater treatment
buyerEvaluationNotes: Evaluated by COD/BOD reduction efficiency, colour removal percentage, sludge volume generation, settling rate in clarifiers, and RO membrane flux recovery.
